name: Loaded Fries
sourceDescription: A black, oval-shaped platter filled with loaded fries topped with a variety of ingredients.

name: French Fries
sourceDescription: A wire basket lined with brown parchment paper holding a serving of golden French fries next to a small ceramic bowl of tomato ketchup.

name: Chicken Momos
sourceDescription: A row of freshly steamed chicken dumplings (momos) is served on a black stone platter with a bowl of dipping sauce. The simple presentation and soft texture make this dish look warm and inviting. Captured in Mankavu, Kozhikode.

name: Veg Momos
sourceDescription: Veg momos with sauce at a Nepali Restaurant, Kathmandu, Nepal

name: Orange Juice
sourceDescription: A chilled glass of fresh orange juice is served with a paper straw, showing its refreshing color and smooth texture. The simple composition creates a clean and appealing drink photograph. Captured in Mankavu, Kozhikode.

name: Pine Apple Juice
sourceDescription: Two glasses of pineapple juice at the peak of the hill.

name: Water Melon Juice
sourceDescription: A tall glass of watermelon juice, garnished with a watermelon slice and a brown straw. The drink is set on a dark wooden table.

name: Lime Juice
sourceDescription: A tall glass of lime juice with a straw on a brown mat in a cozy restaurant at Cherai Beach, Ernakulam.

name: Mint Mojito
sourceDescription: A close-up of a virgin mojito in a tall glass with ice, mint leaves, and lemon and lime slices.

name: Normal Falooda
sourceDescription: Falooda authentic normal calicut special Sangeeth coolbar

name: Parotta
sourceDescription: A flaky, golden parotta is served on a bright yellow plate.

name: Veg Fried Rice
sourceDescription: A plate of Vegetable Fried Rice served with a side of sauce.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
sourceDescription: A close-up of a serving of chicken fried rice, featuring fluffy white rice mixed with diced carrots, scrambled eggs, and pieces of chicken, garnished with chopped green onions. The dish is presented in a black bowl, with a slightly blurred background emphasizing the texture and ingredients of the fried rice. It was captured in Kozhikode, Kerala.

name: Chicken Burger
sourceDescription: A chicken burger with tomato, lettuce and red cabbage on a white plate served with grilled potato wedges on a wooden table, with a toothpick holding the bun in place.

name: Veg Sandwich
sourceDescription: A plate with a vegetable sandwich, crispy fries, and dips of mayonnaise and ketchup.

name: Chicken Gravy
sourceDescription: A white plate with red floral patterns holds a rich, spicy chicken curry. The dish features hearty chunks of chicken in a thick, reddish-brown sauce.

name: Plate Shawarma
sourceDescription: A close-up of shawarma on a yellow plate, topped with shredded grilled meat and creamy sauce.
